acha.hi: Kal raat itni der tak kya kar raha tha?
acha.en: What were you doing so late last night?

acha.hi: Ek series dekh raha tha, ruk hi nahi paaya.
acha.en: I was watching a series, couldn't stop.

acha.hi: Aaj toh neend poori karni padegi.
acha.en: Today I'll have to catch up on sleep.

acha.hi: Sabzi waale ne aaj discount diya.
acha.en: The vegetable seller gave a discount today.

acha.hi: Kya baat hai, kitna bachaya?
acha.en: Nice, how much did you save?

acha.hi: Pura bees rupaye!
acha.en: A whole twenty rupees!

acha.hi: Tere office mein party kab hai?
acha.en: When is the party at your office?

acha.hi: Agle Friday ko, Christmas se pehle.
acha.en: Next Friday, before Christmas.

acha.hi: Kya pehen ke jaayega?
acha.en: What will you wear?

acha.hi: Mera bike phir se start nahi ho raha.
acha.en: My bike isn't starting again.

acha.hi: Mechanic ko dikha de ek baar.
acha.en: Show it to the mechanic once.

acha.hi: Haan, kal subah le jaata hoon.
acha.en: Yes, I'll take it tomorrow morning.

acha.hi: Tujhe cricket dekhna pasand hai?
acha.en: Do you like watching cricket?

acha.hi: Bahut, especially Test match.
acha.en: A lot, especially Test matches.

acha.hi: Wah, tu toh asli fan hai.
acha.en: Wow, you're a real fan.

acha.hi: Ghar ki safai karni hai aaj.
acha.en: I have to clean the house today.

acha.hi: Main help karun?
acha.en: Shall I help?

acha.hi: Haan please, tu kitchen sambhal le.
acha.en: Yes please, you handle the kitchen.

acha.hi: Itni der se kisko call kar raha hai?
acha.en: Who have you been calling for so long?

acha.hi: Customer care ko, koi utha hi nahi raha.
acha.en: Customer care, nobody's picking up.

acha.hi: Hold pe music sun le tab tak.
acha.en: Listen to the hold music till then.

acha.hi: Mujhe Hindi movies bahut pasand hain.
acha.en: I really like Hindi movies.

acha.hi: Koi purani movie suggest kar.
acha.en: Suggest an old movie.

acha.hi: Dil Chahta Hai dekh, maza aayega.
acha.en: Watch Dil Chahta Hai, you'll enjoy it.

bahut.hi: Aaj toh weekend ka poora fayda uthayenge.
bahut.en: Today we'll make the most of the weekend.

bahut.hi: Matlab? Pura din bistar mein?
bahut.en: Meaning? The whole day in bed?

bahut.hi: Bilkul, yahi toh asli aish hai.
bahut.en: Exactly, that's real luxury.

bahut.hi: Usne itna bada kaand kar diya aur chehre pe shikan tak nahi.
bahut.en: He pulled off such a big mess and didn't even flinch.

bahut.hi: Kuch log aise hi hote hain, besharam.
bahut.en: Some people are just like that, shameless.

bahut.hi: Chal chhod, apna mood kyun kharab karein.
bahut.en: Forget it, why spoil our mood.

bahut.hi: Is baar Goa ka plan pakka hai na?
bahut.en: This time the Goa plan is definitely on, right?

bahut.hi: Haan, bas sabki chhutti match ho jaaye.
bahut.en: Yes, if only everyone's leave matches up.

bahut.hi: Har baar yahin pe plan latak jaata hai.
bahut.en: Every time the plan gets stuck right here.

bahut.hi: Maa ke haath ka khaana kuch alag hi hota hai.
bahut.en: Food made by Mum is something else.

bahut.hi: Restaurant waale kitna bhi try kar lein.
bahut.en: No matter how hard restaurants try.

bahut.hi: Sach mein, woh swaad kahin nahi milta.
bahut.en: Really, you won't find that taste anywhere.

bahut.hi: Kal interview hai, haath-pair thande ho rahe hain.
bahut.en: I have an interview tomorrow, I'm getting cold feet.

bahut.hi: Ghabra mat, tu poori tayyari mein hai.
bahut.en: Don't panic, you're fully prepared.

bahut.hi: Bas apne pe bharosa rakh, baaki sab ho jaayega.
bahut.en: Just believe in yourself, the rest will follow.

bahut.hi: Itna paisa udaya, phir bhi kuch kaam ka nahi liya.
bahut.en: Blew so much money and still bought nothing useful.

bahut.hi: Sale ka chakkar hi aisa hota hai.
bahut.en: That's the trap of sales.

bahut.hi: Agli baar list bana ke jaana.
bahut.en: Next time go with a list.

bahut.hi: Woh toh bilkul apne baap pe gaya hai.
bahut.en: He's exactly like his father.

bahut.hi: Haan, wahi gussa, wahi hansi.
bahut.en: Yes, same temper, same laugh.

bahut.hi: Khoon ka asar hai, aur kya.
bahut.en: It's in the genes, what else.

bahut.hi: Bahut ho gaya kaam, ab thoda break banta hai.
bahut.en: Enough work, now a break is due.

bahut.hi: Chal, gol gappe khane chalte hain.
bahut.en: Come on, let's go eat gol gappe.

bahut.hi: Teekhe wale, aur extra meetha paani!
bahut.en: The spicy ones, with extra sweet water!
